paper_metadata.title: Experimental study on the micro-mechanical parameters of Ni-based single-crystal superalloys using nanoindentation and element distribution analysis
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: Ni-based single-crystal superalloys are normally prepared by directional solidification.

Solid solution treatments dissolve eutectic structure in cast samples due to elemental agglomeration in the directional solidification process, changing the solute concentration in inter-dendritic and dendritic arm.

The solution treatment can dissolve the eutectic structure and coarse γ ′ phase, and change the solute concentration difference between the inter-dendritic and the dendritic arm, which has a certain effect on the micromechanical properties of the alloy.
